sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:84

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:84:1
items.html:
All ten Sefirot of Assiya rose upward, and Assiya turned her face toward the face of Yetzira, face to face:
For then ZON sorted out from the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] of Vav and a point, from the discernment of the coarseness of phase four, which is the level of Yechida, and it is regarded that the Nukva too rose to the place of AA, and the coupling of the level of Yechida was made in the place of AA. And this causes that the ZAT of Assiya, too, now rise to the place of Atzilut, and all thirty Sefirot of BYA are found to be entirely holy. And now BYA have been corrected at the utmost of their height. However, this is nevertheless not regarded as the end of correction of BYA, since their whole correction is only by way of the ascents of the worlds, for as yet no correction has come from this to BYA in their own place; rather, they are now regarded as vacant and empty. Therefore this is not a complete correction until BYA themselves, in their own place, return to Atzilut, that is, as they were in AK before the second restriction, and then it is regarded as the end of correction.
